semantic_fixtures.covers: Paid U instant draws three individually, offers an exact private ordered two-card hand selection, and puts the last selected card on top.
Concealed hand-to-library placement publishes no public PermanentMoved identity.
A non-hand selection is rejected without mutating state, followed by a legal answer.
The same seed and accepted resolution decisions reproduce the final state.
Actual Twincast copy and original use separate controller-private choices and result bindings; wrong actor is rejected atomically and only the physical original exits once.
The physical spell remains on Stack during the private choice and exits with exactly one generation change after completion.
Replacement-expanded draws finish before the ordered hand choice; each drawn or placed card changes generation once.
